title: Talent Acquisition Senior Specialist
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Position:**
Talent Acquisition Senior Specialist
  
  
**Previous experience:**
End-to-end Talent Acquisition (Recruiter) experience within a Technology product company, with proven ability to understand requirements and manage job requisitions to effective closures
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad or Bangalore
  
  
**Employment type:**
Full-time regular – Hybrid (50% office)
  
  
**The job**
We are seeking a
**Talent Acquisition Senior Specialist**
to help us source, attract, and hire top engineering talent in India. This role is critical in building high-performing teams across
**Software R&D**
, including
**AI applications development**
and
**Cloud-based enterprise software development**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on experience in
**end-to-end technical recruiting**
within a technology product company, combined with strong stakeholder management, sourcing expertise, and a commitment to delivering an excellent candidate experience
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers to develop and execute effective recruitment strategies for AI and non-AI software R&D roles
* Source and attract talent using job boards, social media, referrals, niche tech communities, and industry events
* Screen, interview, and assess candidates using structured techniques (behavioral, competency-based, technical assessments)
* Manage the end-to-end hiring process, including offer negotiation and closure
* Maintain and optimize applicant tracking systems (e.g., Workday) and candidate databases
* Build and sustain strong professional networks to ensure a pipeline of diverse and high-quality candidates
* Provide market insights and trends to hiring managers to guide talent planning
* Ensure inclusive, and unbiased recruitment process, aligned with AVEVA’s commitment to Inclusion & Equity
* Collaborate with the wider People Team (Talent, Rewards, Employee Experience, People Partners) to continuously improve the hiring process and employer brand

**Essential Capabilities & Skills**

* Proven hands-on experience as a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist or similar role in a technology product organization

Strong technical recruiting expertise across software engineering, with exposure to
**AI/ML, cloud-native, and enterprise software domains**

* Advanced sourcing and networking skills (LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Stack Overflow, Kaggle, AI communities)

Solid understanding of recruitment best practices,
**India labor laws**
, and HR processes
  
  

* Proficiency in ATS tools (Workday preferred)
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with ability to influence at all levels
* Excellent negotiation, time management, and prioritization abilities
* High attention to detail, confidentiality, and professionalism

**Essential Experience**

* 8+ years of end-to-end Talent Acquisition experience within a technology product domain with a sizable global backdrop
* Demonstrated success hiring for AI/ML engineering, cloud, software development, and QA/testing roles in India
* Experience of working in a People Team, showing knowledge of HR policies, processes across the whole employee lifecycle

**People team at AVEVA**
The Talent Acquisition function is part of the People team in AVEVA, together with colleagues in Rewards & Talent, People Technology, Employee Experience and the People Partner team. The TA team is made up of regional teams of TA Specialists, the Early Careers team, TA Operations and Sourcing team and global TA Business Partners. Here, we are entrusted to bring in the best talents, who demonstrate AVEVA culture of Impact, Aspiration, Curiosity & Trust, to drive AVEVA business goal to be the Number One Industrial Software company in the world.
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.
  
  
AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

title: Senior Associate
description:
Proxima is a management and leadership consulting firm established in 2008 in Chennai, India, delivering tailored, transformational solutions.

* The Management Consulting practice enables business scale-up and turnaround across Strategy, People, Operations, Finance, and Markets, including support for strategic investments and capital market access.
* The Leadership Consulting & Executive Search practice helps organizations assess and hire leadership talent aligned with long-term business goals.
* Epsilon Staffing Solutions focuses on hiring entry and mid-level talent and supporting sales and service team expansion through customized recruitment solutions.
* FROST – Frontier School of Transformation delivers structured training programs that build workforce capability by aligning skills with business goals through behavioural, management, and technical learning, using practical and expert-led approaches.

https://www.proximaglobal.in/

**Role Overview**

The Associate / Senior Associate – Delivery (Recruitment) will be responsible for end-to-end execution of recruitment mandates, primarily within the manufacturing sector. The role involves talent sourcing, assessment, candidate management, and client engagement while ensuring timely delivery and achievement of financial as well as profile presentation targets.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Talent Research: Conduct extensive industry research to understand talent landscape across target manufacturing sectors.
* Prepare long lists aligned with client requirements and role specifications.
* Map adjacent and relevant talent pools to expand candidate reach.
* Sourcing: Identify and source relevant candidates through job portals, social media platforms, and headhunting techniques.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of talent across assigned manufacturing sectors.
* Candidate Assessment: Conduct detailed screening and evaluation of candidates.
* Carry out virtual call assessments to evaluate candidate suitability for the position.
* Present shortlisted candidates with comprehensive skill, experience, and competency assessment notes.
* Ensure quality and speed of delivery within defined timelines.
* Delivery & Coordination: Manage interview scheduling, feedback coordination, offer management, and joining follow-ups.
* Ensure seamless communication between candidates and clients.
* Financial Targets: Achieve quarterly and annual revenue targets.
* Pre-Sales Support: Collaborate closely with the Sales/Business Development team and support client acquisition.
* Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with assigned clients and identify opportunities for repeat business.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**

* Timely closure of mandates.
* Quality of candidate submissions.
* Revenue / billing achievement.
* Client satisfaction and retention.
* Candidate experience and conversion ratios.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Graduate (MBA / Postgraduate preferred).
* 4 – 9 years of experience in recruitment, preferably in the manufacturing sector.
* Strong experience in Executive Search methodology.
* Expertise in hiring for Discrete and/or Process manufacturing sectors.
* Proven ability to manage multiple mandates simultaneously.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High ownership and accountability.
* Good Key Account Management capabilities.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

title: US IT Recruitment Coordinator Lead | 5+ Years Experience
description:
Location: SR Nagar, Hyderabad

﻿
We are looking for a proactive, highly organized, and accountable
**US IT Recruitment Coordinator Lead**
to manage a team of 2–4 recruitment coordinators, oversee candidate coordination, and ensure smooth daily recruitment operations.

Key Responsibilities & Expectations

* Lead a team of 2–4 recruitment coordinators and take ownership of daily team execution.
* Review incoming candidate profiles from LinkedIn job postings, evaluate initial fit, and assign profiles to coordinators for screening and follow-up.

* Submit a daily End-of-Day (EOD) report covering profiles received, assignments, screening progress, candidate status, scheduled interviews, pending follow-ups, and next-day priorities.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and ensure complete visibility into every active candidate.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, attention to detail, integrity, and the ability to operate independently without constant supervision.

Experience

5+ years in US IT recruitment or recruitment coordination, with experience leading a small team.

Ideal Candidate

A hands-on coordinator lead with excellent communication, organization, follow-up discipline, and team coordination skills. Someone who takes complete ownership of daily recruitment operations and keeps management informed without being asked.

Note

This is an internal recruitment coordination and team execution role. No client interaction, business development, or sales responsibilities are required.

title: Senior Hiring - AIML (BFS)
description:
As part of this role, you will:

·      
**End-to-End Risk & Analytics Modelling**
: Lead the full data science lifecycle—from data sourcing, cleaning, feature engineering, and exploratory analysis to developing, validating, and deploying sophisticated predictive models across risk and customer analytics use cases.

·      
**Risk & Credit Modelling**
: Design and oversee advanced Time-to-Default / Probability of Default models, incorporating behavioural, transactional, financial, and other relevant data to improve risk prediction, portfolio monitoring, and decision-making.

·      
**Fraud Analytics & Detection**
: Develop and review sophisticated fraud detection models using Machine Learning, statistical techniques, anomaly detection, and behavioural patterns to identify emerging fraud risks and minimize financial losses.

·      
**Customer Propensity Modelling**
: Build and optimize propensity-to-churn and customer behaviour models to identify at-risk customers, understand behavioural drivers, and enable targeted retention and engagement strategies.

·      
**Actuarial & Statistical Modelling**
: Apply advanced actuarial models, statistical techniques, and predictive analytics to support pricing, risk assessment, forecasting, portfolio management, and business planning.

·      
**Advanced Algorithmic Design**
: Evaluate, select, and develop appropriate Machine Learning, Deep Learning, statistical, and predictive modelling approaches, ensuring strong model accuracy, interpretability, stability, and statistical robustness.

·      
**Model Validation & Deep Technical Review**
: Remain deeply hands-on in reviewing model design, assumptions, feature engineering, methodologies, validation approaches, performance metrics, and code. Challenge technical decisions and ensure models meet rigorous quality and business standards.

·      
**Production-Scale MLOps**
: Establish and optimize end-to-end MLOps frameworks, covering model development, version control, deployment, monitoring, model performance tracking, drift detection, retraining, and operational governance across cloud environments.

·      
**Model Governance & Operationalization**
: Define and enforce best practices for model governance, documentation, validation, explainability, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management, ensuring models are production-ready and scalable.

·      
**Strategic Planning & Thought Leadership**
: Drive the analytics roadmap by identifying high-value opportunities, defining modelling priorities, anticipating emerging analytical needs, and shaping the organization's Data Science and AI strategy.

·      
**Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Management**
: Represent the Data Science function with senior management and enterprise stakeholders. Communicate complex analytical findings, model outcomes, risks, and recommendations clearly and confidently, translating technical insights into business decisions and strategic actions.

·      
**Team Leadership & Mentorship**
: Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams of data scientists, ML engineers, and analytics professionals. Set technical standards, promote deep analytical thinking, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.

**Who do we expect ?**

●       
**12+ years of total experience**
in Data Science, Machine Learning, Advanced Analytics, Risk Analytics, Fraud Analytics, Actuarial Analytics, or related quantitative disciplines, with significant experience as a hands-on, code-writing practitioner.

●       
**5+ years of proven leadership experience**
managing, mentoring, and growing specialized Data Science / ML teams delivering production-grade analytical solutions.

●        Strong experience in Risk & Predictive Modeling: Demonstrated expertise in Time-to-Default / Probability of Default, fraud modeling, propensity-to-churn, customer behavior modeling, and/or actuarial models.

●        Deep hands-on technical expertise: Strong command of Machine Learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, Python, SQL, and relevant ML frameworks. Should be capable of going deep into model methodologies, assumptions, feature engineering, code, validation, and performance rather than operating purely at a managerial level.

●        Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Actuarial Science, Economics, or another highly quantitative discipline (preferred).

Domain Track Record: Prior experience delivering production-grade analytics and predictive modeling solutions within Banking, Financial Services, Insurance, FinTech, or other highly analytical and risk-intensive sectors.

description:
**Associate Manager, Talent Sourcing (GBS)**

About Randstad Enterprise

As the leading global talent solutions provider, Randstad Enterprise enables companies to create sustainable business value and agility by keeping people at the heart of their organizations. Part of Randstad N.V., we combine unmatched talent data and market insights with smart technologies and deep people expertise. Our integrated talent solutions — delivered by Randstad Advisory, Randstad Sourceright and Randstad RiseSmart — help companies build skilled and agile workforces that move their businesses forward. Randstad Enterprise supports some of the world's most renowned brands to build their talent acquisition and management models that not only meet their business needs today but also in the future. We offer solutions in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region, Asia Pacific (APAC) region as well as in North America (NAM) region. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive mind-set.

● Our solutions know no limits, we have proven experience delivering market-leading MSP, RPO, Total Talent, and Services Procurement Solutions including technology, talent marketing, talent intelligence, and workforce consulting services.

● We create the best talent experience, from attraction to onboarding and onto ongoing career development, we understand the human and digital touchpoints that compel talent to join and stay with a company.

● We know where the talent of tomorrow is, how they behave, what they are looking for, and how to build their loyalty toward a specific company employer brand.

● We push the boundaries of our industry to be able to see around the corner for our clients, continually investing in innovation to stay ahead in our market.

**About Team**

Our team is a group of talented and dedicated professionals who are passionate about our work and committed to delivering exceptional results. We are a global group that values collaboration, open communication, and a supportive work environment. Our team is responsible for Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Recruiting Operations for partnering with a global fortune-500 client and we take pride in the important role we play in achieving the goals of our client's business. We are a diverse group with a range of skills and backgrounds, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. We are committed to fostering a culture of learning and growth, and we encourage each other to take on new challenges and develop our skills. We believe in working hard and having fun, and we enjoy celebrating our successes together as a team.

Purpose of the Role

● Develops sourcing strategies that enhance candidate experience, ensuring a personalized approach to project-based job opportunities.

● Works closely with the clients' hiring teams, ensuring all KPIs and SLA requirements regarding order-based sourcing and talent conversion from passive candidates are met.

● Monitors and analyzes recruitment metrics and data to identify areas for improvement and optimize the recruitment process for passive and active candidates, considering candidates with limited online presence.

● Stays informed of industry best practices and trends in the career/hiring space, continually assessing where Randstad can tap into project-based jobs.

● Leads sourcing activities/projects and drives to meet the key metrics goals as set by leadership, focusing on proactive engagement and headhunting of passive talent.

● Drives continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing sourcing efficiency and effectiveness.

● Manages candidates and ensures that the most qualified candidates are shortlisted for clients' short-term engagements.

**Key Responsibilities**

● SLA & KPI Management: You will track the team's daily and monthly hiring targets. You'll look at the data to make sure candidates are moving through the hiring stages quickly and efficiently.

● Capacity & Demand Planning: You will look at incoming hiring requests and assign work to your team fairly, making sure they can handle sudden rushes of new job openings.

● Upskilling & Mentorship: You will coach and train your team members to improve their sourcing skills, teaching them how to find hard-to-reach tech professionals.

● Advanced Sourcing Frameworks: You will build smart plans to find passive candidates (people who aren't actively looking for a job) for complex IT roles like Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security.

● AI & Tech Stack Optimization: You will guide the team on how to best use modern recruitment tools, databases, and AI sourcing technology to work faster and smarter.

● Process Agility & Continuous Improvement: You will find ways to fix delays or blockers in the sourcing process so everything runs smoothly and quickly.

● Client & Stakeholder Management: You will work closely with the client’s hiring managers, sharing updates regularly, building strong relationships, and making sure we meet their expectations.

● Quality Assurance: You will check the quality of candidates your team finds to ensure only the best-vetted profiles are sent to the client.

Grade Descriptor

● Good understanding of procedures and concepts within own discipline and knowledge of these elements in other disciplines.

● Provides management and operational oversight to large and/or moderately complex business or technical support team members, potentially including work leaders.

● Sets priorities for the team to ensure task completion; coordinates work activities with other supervisors/team leaders.

● Responsible for end results of the team.

● Provides input on resource planning, guidelines, processes and procedures.

● Solves problems guided by policies and procedures; receives guidance from manager.

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
About MRK and the role

MRK (MetroRide Kids) runs safe, reliable school rides for children across Hyderabad. Parents trust us with their kids every morning and afternoon, so the quality of our drivers is the quality of our service.

As Driver Recruiter, you will own high-volume hiring of gig drivers and DCOs (Driver-cum-Owners) for MRK. You will source, screen, verify and onboard drivers who are safe, punctual and good with children, and keep the pipeline full as we add schools and routes.

Key responsibilities

•     
**Sourcing:**
Run high-volume driver hiring through referrals, driver hubs, stands, transport unions, local agencies, WhatsApp/Facebook groups, job portals (Apna, WorkIndia, Naukri) and walk-in drives.

•     
**DCO acquisition:**
Identify and onboard Driver-cum-Owners with suitable vehicles; explain the earning model, attachment terms and payout cycles clearly.

•     
**Screening:**
Conduct phone and in-person screening for driving skill, route knowledge, punctuality, communication and suitability to ride with children.

•     
**Verification:**
Coordinate document checks (DL, badge, RC, insurance, permit, fitness, PUC, Aadhaar, PAN), police verification and background checks; ensure zero gaps before a driver goes live.

•     
**Driving & vehicle checks:**
Schedule driving tests and vehicle inspections with the operations team.

•     
**Onboarding:**
Run induction on child safety, conduct norms, app usage and SOPs; hand over trained drivers to ops on time for route launches.

•     
**Pipeline & reporting:**
Maintain the candidate tracker and CRM; report daily/weekly funnel numbers (leads, screened, verified, onboarded, active) and turnaround times.

•     
**Retention & re-hiring:**
Track early attrition, collect exit reasons, re-engage dropped-off drivers and build a bench for peak demand and replacements.

•     
**Vendor & community management:**
Build relationships with driver agencies, fleet owners and local networks to keep a steady supply.

Requirements

•     1–5 years of experience hiring gig drivers, DCOs or delivery partners (ride-hailing, school/staff transport, logistics, quick commerce or similar).

•     Proven track record of high-volume, fast-turnaround blue-collar hiring.

•     Strong network of drivers, fleet owners and agencies in Hyderabad.

•     Working knowledge of driver documents, commercial vehicle permits and background verification processes.

•     Fluent in Telugu and Hindi; working English.

•     Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and a CRM or applicant tracker.

•     Willing to work from the Hyderabad office and travel locally for sourcing drives.

•     Graduate in any discipline.

Good to have

•     Experience hiring for school transport, kids' mobility or other child-safety-sensitive roles.

•     Experience onboarding EV drivers or EV fleet partners.

•     Familiarity with Zoho CRM or Zoho Recruit.

•     Two-wheeler and a valid driving licence for field sourcing.

What we offer

•     Competitive salary with performance incentives on hiring targets.

•     Ownership of driver supply for a fast-growing kids' mobility business.

•     A mission that matters: getting children to school safely every day.

**How to apply:**
Send your CV to hr@metroride.com with the subject line "Driver Recruiter – MRK Hyderabad".

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator - Contract Role
description:
**Job Description**
The Talent Acquisition Coordinator (TAC) is responsible for driving efficient and consistent recruiting
  
  
operations that support the successful hiring of top talent. By partnering with recruiters, hiring managers,
  
  
and candidates, this role ensures a positive candidate experience, seamless interview coordination, and
  
  
effective execution of pre-employment processes. The TAC contributes to operational excellence through
  
  
strong attention to detail, process adherence, and exceptional stakeholder support
  
  
Job Type: Contractor – 1-year contract – under 3rd party employer (Vendor - Ascent)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Interview Scheduling & Coordination
  
  

* Manage end-to-end interview scheduling across multiple regions and time zones
* Coordinate complex interview panels, including executive-level interviews
* Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to confirm interview structure, timelines, and logistics
* Monitor scheduling SLAs and proactively resolve conflicts, reschedules, and no-shows

Candidate Experience
  
  

* Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process
* Communicate interview details, expectations, and logistics in a clear and timely manner
* Ensure a positive, professional, and high-touch candidate experience
* Manage interview reminders and day-of coordination support

Recruiting Operations Support
  
  

* Maintain accurate candidate data and statuses within Workday (or ATS)
* Support recruiters with requisition activity, interview tracking, and process updates
* Ensure timely documentation and dispositioning of candidates
* Track and follow up on interview feedback and next steps

Pre-Employment & Offer Support
  
  

* Coordinate pre-employment activities such as background checks and documentation
* Partner with recruiters and HR teams to support offer processes
* Monitor completion of pre-hire requirements and escalate issues when needed

Process Excellence & Collaboration
  
  

* Act as a key partner to recruiters and hiring managers to ensure efficient process flow
* Identify opportunities to improve scheduling, coordination, and candidate experience
* Adhere to defined SOPs, SLAs, and compliance requirements
* Support global operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

* 1–2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or HR Operations
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize high-volume work
* Experience coordinating meetings, schedules, or logistics across multiple stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy

* Experience supporting recruiting or HR processes in a corporate environment
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (e.g., Workday) and scheduling tools (e.g., Rooster)

Strong coordination and problem-solving skills

* Collaboration and stakeholder management

title: Head of People & Talent Acquisition
description:
**ITHI · JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Head of People & Talent Acquisition**

Hyderabad · Full-time · Reports to the Founder & CEO

ITHI is a connection-first discovery and collaboration platform for Indian cinema, built on the belief that all 24 filmmaking crafts carry equal dignity. We are hiring our first dedicated people leader — someone who can build the team that takes ITHI from ideation to market release, and who can tell a strong designer, engineer, tester or marketer from a weak one before the interview loop begins.

**Reports to**

Founder & CEO

**Location**

Hyderabad, on-site; travel to campuses and industry events

**Experience**

6–10 years in HR, 3+ hiring for product and technology teams

**What you will do**

•
**Plan the workforce.**
Turn the product roadmap into a hiring plan by department, role, seniority and timing; decide full-time vs contract vs agency with the founder.

•
**Own talent acquisition end to end.**
Write role-specific JDs, source through LinkedIn, Naukri, Wellfound, Behance, GitHub and film, media and design schools, and run first-level screening with real technical and craft judgment.

•
**Design fair evaluations.**
Build assignments, portfolio reviews and interview loops per role; manage offers, negotiation and reference checks.

•
**Onboard into two worlds.**
Teach new hires the product and the industry.

•
**Build the people function.**
Policies, handbook, payroll coordination, statutory compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, POSH), and contracts with IP, confidentiality and NDA clauses.

•
**Care for culture and retention.**
Run feedback and growth conversations, handle grievances with discretion, and run internship tracks with partner colleges.

**Who you are**

**Must have**

• At least 5 years in HR or talent acquisition, at least 2 hiring for product, design and engineering teams.

• Fluency in tech hiring.

• Experience building an HR function from scratch - policies, compliance, performance cycles.

• Working knowledge of Indian labour law, POSH and the DPDP Act for employee and candidate data.

• Warm, clear communication in English and Telugu; Hindi is a plus. Discretion with unreleased creative work and personal data.

**Good to have**

• Hiring for media, entertainment, OTT or creator-economy companies; a network in the South Indian film industry.

• Campus hiring with film, media, design or engineering colleges; managing freelancers and creative agencies.

**What success looks like**

•
**In 90 days:**
a 12-month hiring plan, screening rubrics for each department, core HR policies and contracts in place, and the first priority roles hired or in final rounds.

•
**In 12 months:**
every stage of the product cycle has a clear owner, hiring managers see short and strong shortlists, and time-to-hire and retention are tracked and improving.

**How to apply**

Send your resume and a one-page note on how you would build ITHI’s first 5 hires to
**hr@ithi.world**
with the subject line “Head of People — ITHI”. The process: founder call, a case exercise ranking five anonymised profiles for a sample ITHI role, a panel with team leads, and a final conversation.

*ITHI is an equal-opportunity employer. Every craft carries equal dignity — and so does every applicant.*

title: Recruiter, Early-in-Profession
description:
**Overview**
The Early-in-Profession (EIP) recruiting team provides opportunities where you can shape your career with purpose, where early talent is empowered through structured frameworks, inclusive hiring, and global exposure to high-impact roles. Our recruiting team thrives in driving innovation in AI, engineering, and programme delivery, while cultivating talent through proactive sourcing and continuous learning.
  
  
Do you enjoy solving hiring challenges, partnering closely with business leaders, and connecting great talent with opportunities where they can make an impact? Come join Microsoft’s Global Talent Acquisition team as a
**Recruiter supporting Microsoft Commercial Business (MCB) & Microsoft Frontier Company.**
In this role, you will partner with hiring managers and recruiting colleagues to understand business priorities, develop effective hiring strategies, and attract talent for one of Microsoft’s key customer-facing businesses. You will combine recruiting expertise, talent-market insights, data, and strong candidate engagement to deliver hiring outcomes and an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring teams.
  
  
You may be a fit for this role if you:
  
  

* Thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and agility matters.
* Enjoy building trusted relationships with hiring managers and translating business needs into recruiting strategies.
* Are curious about talent markets and use data and insights to inform your approach.
* Enjoy identifying and engaging talent in competitive markets.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and disciplined follow-through.
* Care deeply about candidate experience and representing Microsoft authentically in the talent market.
* Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving how work gets done.
* Are excited about using new technologies, including AI, to improve recruiting effectiveness.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Stakeholder Engagement & Hiring Strategy**

* Lead recruiting strategy and kickoff discussions with hiring managers to understand role requirements, business priorities, candidate profiles, and hiring timelines.
* Partner with MCB stakeholders to translate hiring demand into effective recruiting and talent strategies.
* Manage multiple hiring priorities while setting clear expectations and proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
* Conduct regular pipeline and hiring reviews with stakeholders and recommend actions based on recruiting progress and talent-market conditions.
* Consult with hiring managers and interview teams to support skills-based and inclusive hiring practices.

**Talent Market Insights & Hiring Plans**

* Leverage market research, recruiting data, and talent insights to understand talent availability and inform hiring strategies.
* Identify opportunities to broaden talent pools and recommend sourcing approaches based on business needs.
* Analyze recruiting and assessment outcomes to identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness.
* Monitor progress against agreed recruiting goals and use data to enable informed conversations with hiring teams.

**Talent Attraction & Sourcing**

* Develop sourcing strategies to identify and engage qualified talent for current and future MCB & Frontier Co hiring needs.
* Build and nurture talent pipelines using relevant sourcing channels, professional communities, referrals, internal talent pools, and other approaches.
* Engage prospective candidates with compelling stories about Microsoft, MCB & Frontier Co, the opportunity, and potential career impact.
* Adapt sourcing strategies based on talent-market conditions and pipeline health.

**Candidate Assessment & Experience**

* Assess candidates against role requirements using skills-based evaluation, behavioral interviewing, and established assessment approaches.
* Understand candidate motivations, interests, and career aspirations to create meaningful engagement throughout the hiring process.
* Provide a differentiated candidate experience by anticipating candidate needs, proactively addressing concerns, and maintaining timely engagement.
* Partner with hiring teams to review candidate assessment outcomes and provide recommendations based on role requirements.
* Use appropriate negotiation techniques and knowledge of candidate motivators to support successful hiring outcomes.

**Recruiting Excellence**

* Coordinate effectively across hiring teams and Global Talent Acquisition partner teams to progress candidates through the hiring process.
* Maintain accurate and timely recruiting data to enable reliable reporting, compliance, and decision-making.
* Follow established recruiting processes and applicable standards throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Participate in recruiting programs, projects, and change initiatives that improve the effectiveness of Talent Acquisition.
* Explore and responsibly adopt AI-enabled recruiting solutions and share practices that improve team workflows and decision-making.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset by actively seeking feedback, developing recruiting and business expertise, and sharing knowledge with colleagues.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree AND well experienced in talent acquisition (e.g recruiting, sourcing, campus hiring) OR equivalent experience.
* Strong critical thinking, judgment capability and communications skills, with the ability to engage and consult in strategic hiring discussions.
* Proficient with a data-driven approach to recruiting, using talent insights, market intelligence, hiring data and competitor analysis to drive impactful hiring outcomes.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full-cycle experience in supporting sales roles, customer-facing, go-to-market, technical, or related business functions.
* Experience in university recruiting or volume hiring for early-in-career talents is a big plus.
* Experience managing multiple hiring priorities and partnering effectively with stakeholders in a matrixed environment.
* Strong learning agility and aptitude in navigating ambiguity, collaborating across teams, and continuously improving how work gets done.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

description:
* **Job Title: US IT, Non-IT & Pharma Bench Sales Recruiter**
* **Experience:**
  3-8 years
* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, Telangana, India
* **Shift Timing:**
  US Night Shift ([Insert Hours, e.g., 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST])
* **Job Type:**
  Full-Time
* **Industry:**
  US Staffing, Consulting, & Life Sciences

**Job Overview**

We are looking for an ambitious, multi-domain
**US Bench Sales Recruiter**
with proven expertise in marketing consultants across
**Information Technology (IT), Corporate/Non-IT, and Pharmaceutical/Life Sciences**
sectors.

In this role, you will take ownership of a diverse consultant pool (H-1B, OPT, CPT, H4-EAD, Green Card, and US Citizens). Your core objective is to minimize bench downtime by aggressively mapping skills to open market demands, securing
**Right to Represent (RTR)**
agreements, submitting profiles to Tier-1 prime vendors and direct clients, and closing profitable C2C or W-2 contracts.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Multi-Domain Consultant Marketing**

* **IT Verticals:**
  Market software developers, cloud/DevOps engineers, data analysts, and QA automation specialists.
* **Non-IT Verticals:**
  Market finance/accounting professionals, HR specialists, supply chain experts, and administrative consultants.
* **Pharma & Life Sciences Verticals:**
  Market clinical SAS programmers, clinical data managers, pharmacovigilance (PV) specialists, regulatory affairs associates, and validation/compliance engineers.
* Prepare customized, targeted "Hotlists" and market them daily to an established network of US prime vendors, MSPs, and implementation partners.
* JobLeads



**2. Sourcing & Submissions**

* Source C2C and W-2 contract requirements across US job boards (Dice, TechFetch, Indeed, LinkedIn, and specialized life-science/corporate portals).
* Review and filter job postings to align with candidate tech stacks, regulatory backgrounds, geographic choices, and remote/onsite constraints.
* Secure signed
  **Right to Represent (RTR)**
  confirmations and swiftly submit tailored resumes to prime vendors.



**3. Rate Negotiation & Closures**

* Negotiate competitive bill rates with vendors and fair pay rates with consultants to ensure optimal profit margins for the company.
* Coordinate multi-round technical, compliance, and client interviews between vendors and bench consultants.
* Drive the end-to-end placement cycle, including background checks, onboarding document coordination, and initial project start confirmation.



**4. Vendor Relationship Management**

* Build and preserve long-term professional relationships with US account managers, delivery managers, and tier-1 vendor lists.
* Maintain clean daily logs in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) tracking submissions, interview statuses, active hotlists, and vendor feedback.

**Key Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  [Insert, e.g., 2 to 5+] years of core experience in US Bench Sales recruitment, with a track record spanning IT and either Pharma/Life Sciences or Non-IT staffing.
* **Domain Fluency:**
  Basic understanding or ability to quickly grasp technical stacks, corporate workflows, and clinical research/regulatory terms (e.g., SAS, CDISC, SDTM, GxP validation).
* **US Staffing & Visa Knowledge:**
  Sound understanding of US work authorizations (
  **H-1B, OPT, H4-EAD, Green Card, US Citizen**
  ) and contract models (
  **C2C, W-2, 1099**
  ).
* **Communication & Negotiation:**
  Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills to interact smoothly with corporate US staffing partners.
* **Target-Driven:**
  Goal-oriented approach with a proven history of meeting daily submission benchmarks and securing monthly placement quotas.
* **Shift Flexibility:**
  Readiness to work US night shifts consistently.

title: Recruiter - 12 month FTC
description:
**Company Description**
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
  
  
**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
  
  
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
  
  
**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
More about
**our mission**
and
**what we offer**
.
  
  
As a Recruiter at Wise you’ll be responsible for hiring the best talent for Servicing Operations in Hyderabad. You’ll own talent management, helping Servicing Operations to scale to enable Wise to achieve our mission - money without borders. You’ll be a key member of the recruitment team with a focus on delivering exceptional talent while keeping candidate and hiring manager experience front and centre of what you do.
  
  
Culture is everything to us at Wise and identifying, finding and selecting the best talent to support our highly collaborative and non-hierarchical culture is key. As a Recruiter you are vital to the overall success of Wise. The right person will have an excellent knowledge of talent management and understand how to partner effectively.
  
  
**Your Mission**

* You’ll help us scale our Servicing Operations teams over the next few years so we can help more customers save money using Wise
* You’ll manage candidates end-to-end ensuring they receive the best possible experience in line with Wise values, even if they weren’t successful (you never know, the perfect role might come up later), and build a strong talent network locally and internationally
* You’ll build and develop relationships with with hiring teams, guiding them through processes
* Always seeking growth opportunities, not afraid to step outside of your comfort zone and take a risk
* Collaborate with sourcers to understand the candidate market and engage the best talent
* Use data to support your hiring recommendations, as well as using it to retro processes, figure out the blockers to hiring, communicate how these can be overcome and continually optimise the process to make sure it is globally scalable
* You'll partner with hiring teams and other People teams (e.g. People Operations), to support various initiatives (e.g. referral programs, talent mapping, salary benchmarking, etc)

**Qualifications**
A bit about you:
  
  

* You have a proven track record of hiring exceptional talent while delivering the best partnering experience to candidates and hiring teams
* You are an adaptable self-starter - someone who can use their own initiative to keep things running at pace and won’t wait for answers
* You are good with tooling and make data driven decisions by running reports, building dashboards and implementing new systems
* You are resilient and curious by nature - you like flipping ambiguity, failures and set-backs in their head by actually using them as learning opportunities
* You are a creative problem solver. A tricky role won’t get you down. It’s a challenge that just spurs you on to find a new approach and try something new. You're curious and get a real kick out of learning different skills
* You are a confident communicator and influencer, comfortable talking to people of any level, whether it’s in person, on the phone or in writing. You understand how best to adapt your approach to your audience

Key Attributes
  
  

* Data Driven. You’re able to use data to build narratives and influence change. You can make evidence-based decisions and you’re able to use data to measure impact
* Flexible & adaptable. You’re able to switch effectively between tasks and deal with constantly-changing workload and priorities.
* Initiative. You’re able to identify and seize opportunities. You can work with limited guidance to solve problems.
* Big Thinker. You understand the impact of your work on the success of the company. You’re able to create well thought-through action plans built around the big picture. You consider others and you’re aware of the impact your work has on other teams. You’re always thinking and planning for scalable and sustainable solutions

Additional Information
  
  
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
  
  
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
  
  
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
  
  
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
  
  
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

**LinkedIn Sourcing & Recruitment**

* Maintain LinkedIn sourcing trackers, candidate pipelines, and follow-up records.
* Demonstrate a proven track record of successfully closing positions through LinkedIn sourcing.

**Domestic Hiring & Internal Recruitment**

* Handle end-to-end domestic recruitment for internal positions based in India.
* Recruit for positions including:
* Bench Sales Recruiters
* U.S. HR Operations Executives
* U.S. Immigration Specialists
* U.S. Accounts and Payroll Executives
* Account Managers
* Business Development Executives
* Other internal operational and support roles
* Understand hiring requirements and coordinate with management to finalize job descriptions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, referrals, and other recruitment platforms.
* Screen candidates based on relevant experience, communication skills, salary expectations, notice periods, and shift availability.
* Conduct initial HR screening interviews and shortlist suitable candidates.
* Coordinate virtual and face-to-face interviews with hiring managers.
* Manage interview scheduling, feedback collection, and candidate follow-ups.
* Handle salary negotiations, offer discussions, and joining confirmations.
* Follow up regularly to minimize interview no-shows, offer dropouts, and joining delays.
* Maintain recruitment databases, ATS records, and daily/weekly hiring reports.
* Ensure timely closure of hiring requirements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **2–5 years of hands-on experience in domestic recruitment or internal talent acquisition.**
* **Mandatory hands-on experience in LinkedIn sourcing and successfully hiring candidates through LinkedIn.**
* Strong expertise in LinkedIn search, Boolean searches, candidate outreach, and headhunting.
* Proven experience managing end-to-end recruitment independently.
* Strong candidate screening, interview coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Experience handling multiple hiring requirements simultaneously.

title: Senior HR Recruiter
description:
**Role Overview**
The Senior HR Recruiter owns full-cycle hiring across engineering, security, design and marketing roles in four countries. You will run searches from intake to joining, raise the bar on candidate quality, and help build a hiring process that scales.
  
  
This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will work directly with hiring managers and leadership, and mentor junior recruiters as the team grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Full-cycle recruitment**

* Run end-to-end hiring for technical and non-technical roles: intake, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer and onboarding handoff.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, scorecards and interview plans.
* Manage open requisitions at a time across India, Indonesia, Singapore and the UAE.

**Sourcing and talent pipelines**

* Source passive candidates via LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, security communities and referrals.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines for recurring roles such as DevSecOps engineers, security instructors and fullstack developers.
* Write compelling job descriptions and outreach messages that reflect our brand.

**Assessment and selection**

* Conduct structured screening interviews against defined competencies.
* Use standardized scorecards and screening question sets to keep evaluation fair and consistent.
* Give hiring managers clear, evidence-based candidate summaries and recommendations.

**Offers and closing**

* Benchmark compensation by market and prepare offer letters and salary structures.
* Negotiate offers and manage candidates through acceptance and joining.
* Ensure offers comply with local employment norms in each country.

**Process, data and reporting**

* Keep the ATS accurate and up to date.
* Track and report hiring metrics: time-to-hire, source quality, offer acceptance and pipeline health.
* Improve hiring processes, templates and SOPs as the company scales.

**Employer Brand And Candidate Experience**

* Deliver a timely, respectful candidate experience at every stage.
* Mentor junior recruiters and coordinators.

**Employee data and support**

* Maintain accurate, confidential employee records, including personal details, contracts, joining documents and exits, in the HRMS or employee database.
* Act as the first point of contact for employee queries on HR policies, documentation, leave and onboarding.
* Coordinate with payroll, finance and managers to keep employee information current across India, Indonesia, Singapore and the UAE.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology or a related field; an MBA in HR is a plus.
* 5–8 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, including at least 2 years hiring for tech, SaaS or cybersecurity roles.
* Proven record of closing hard-to-fill technical roles such as security engineers, DevOps or developers.
* Strong sourcing skills: LinkedIn Recruiter and passive candidate outreach.
* Working knowledge of at least one ATS and comfort with spreadsheets and hiring data.
* Experience preparing offer letters and negotiating compensation.
* Excellent written and spoken English; clear, confident communication with candidates and leaders.
* Able to manage many requisitions at once while keeping quality and pace high.

**Nice to have**

* Has hired for security roles such as penetration testers, AppSec engineers or security trainers, and understands certifications like OSCP, CISSP and CEH.
* Has built a recruitment function or hiring process from scratch at a startup or scale-up.
* Has run cross-border hiring, including contractor and employer-of-record setups.
* Has used recruitment analytics or dashboards to improve hiring decisions.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary, benchmarked to market and experience.
* Ownership of hiring across four countries and a direct line to leadership.
* Remote or hybrid work with flexible hours.
* A fast-growing global team where your work is visible from day one.

**How To Apply**
Send your resume and a short note on a hard-to-fill role you closed and how you did it. Shortlisted candidates move through a screening call, a hiring manager interview, a practical sourcing exercise and a final round with leadership.
  
  
*PDSO is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background.*

We are looking for a dynamic, results-driven, and experienced
**Bench Sales Professional**
with 3 to 8 years of expertise in US IT Staffing. The ideal candidate will be responsible for marketing our IT consultants (on H1B, OPT, EAD, GC, and US Citizen visas) to tier-1 vendors, prime vendors, and direct clients. You will act as a bridge between available consultant talent and high-paying project requirements, focusing on minimizing bench time and maximizing profit margins.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Consultant Marketing & Placement:**
  Proactively market available IT consultants (W2/C2C) across various technologies (Java, Data Engineering, Cloud/DevOps, Full Stack, QA, Salesforce, etc.) to get them placed on billable projects quickly.

  Leverage existing networks and build new relationships with Tier-1 vendors, Prime Vendors, and Direct Clients to secure direct requirements.
* **Portal Sourcing & Database Management:**
  Utilize job portals, job boards, and social media platforms (Dice, Monster/Monster Worldwide, CareerBuilder, LinkedIn, Corp-Corp, Telegram/WhatsApp groups) to source requirements and map consultant skills.
* **Submission & Interview Coordination:**
  Submit tailored resumes to daily requirements, line up interviews, prepare consultants for client technical rounds, and follow up on feedback.
* **Rate Negotiation & Closing:**
  Negotiate profitable bill rates and terms with vendors, and finalize pay rates/salaries with consultants.
* **Compliance & Documentation:**
  Ensure compliance with company guidelines, tax terms (W2, Corp-to-Corp, 1099), and immigration regulations (H1B transfers, extensions, and visa stipulations).
* **Target Achievement:**
  Meet and exceed daily/weekly key performance metrics (KPIs) including number of submissions, interview linings, and successful project closures.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  3 to 8 years of proven experience in US IT Bench Sales.
* **Knowledge Base:**
  Comprehensive understanding of US Tax Terms (W2, C2C, 1099) and various visa categories (H1B, OPT/CPT EAD, H4 EAD, GC, US Citizens).
* **Network:**
  Strong existing Rolodex/network of Tier-1 vendors, staffing partners, and direct client contacts in the US market.
* **Communication & Negotiation:**
  Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with aggressive negotiation, persuasion, and closing abilities.
* **Tech-Savvy:**
  Familiarity with ATS (Applicant Tracking Systems) and job boards (Dice, LinkedIn Recruiter, Corp-Corp).
* **Target-Oriented:**
  High energy, self-motivated, and capable of thriving in a fast-paced, competitive, and target-driven environment.

description:
**About the Company:**

ANSR partners with the world’s leading enterprises to design, build, manage, and operate Global Capability Centers (GCCs) that power global growth. As the market leader in GCC transformation, ANSR has established 200+ centers worldwide, hiring over 200,000 professionals, managing 12 million sq. ft. of enterprise workspace, and enabling $2.2B+ in cumulative investments.

Our end-to-end solutions simplify global expansion by seamlessly integrating talent, HR, workspace, technology, and compliance across the world’s premier talent hubs. By combining deep operational expertise with technology-led innovation, we help enterprises scale with speed, precision, and confidence.

At the heart of our ecosystem is 1Wrk, our AI-powered global work platform that unifies people, processes, and infrastructure into one cohesive operating model, empowering organizations to access world-class talent and drive sustainable, long-term success.

Backed by Accenture, Accel Partners, and ServiceNow, ANSR blends technological innovation with operational excellence to help enterprises build their global future.

**Role Overview:**
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Recruitment Specialist to drive talent acquisition for technology roles across multiple levels. This role will focus on building strong talent pipelines, delivering high-quality candidates, and partnering with stakeholders to ensure efficient hiring outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong sourcing expertise, stakeholder management skills, and a data-driven approach to recruitment in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Talent Acquisition Delivery:**

* Execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with client and business requirements.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment for assigned roles, ensuring timely delivery of quality candidates.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across entry-level to senior technology roles.

**Candidate Sourcing & Engagement:**

* Source, identify, and engage candidates through multiple channels including job boards, social platforms, and networking.
* Apply advanced sourcing techniques to attract high-quality and niche talent.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

**Stakeholder Management & Collaboration:**

* Partner with recruiters, hiring managers, and client stakeholders to understand role requirements and hiring priorities.
* Act as a point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment on hiring progress.
* Support escalation handling and ensure timely resolution of hiring challenges.

**Talent Intelligence & Reporting:**

* Conduct candidate mapping and talent market research to support hiring strategies.
* Provide talent insights and market intelligence to stakeholders.
* Track and report key recruitment metrics (KPIs) and pipeline progress on a periodic basis.

**Process & System Management:**

* Ensure accurate and timely updates in Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) or client platforms.
* Maintain data integrity across job postings, candidate records, and hiring workflows.
* Support continuous improvement of recruitment processes and best practices.

**Team Support & Coordination:**

* Assist Recruitment Managers in guiding sourcing specialists and coordinators.
* Support interview coordination and hiring logistics to ensure a seamless process.
* Collaborate with team members to deliver a consistent and high-quality hiring experience.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA/PG in HR preferred.
* 4+ years of experience in technology talent acquisition with exposure to end-to-end recruitment.
* Proven experience in sourcing and engaging candidates across multiple levels.
* Strong understanding of recruitment processes, stakeholder management, and hiring delivery models.
* Hands-on experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment tools.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and presentations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in candidate mapping and talent market research.
* Ability to manage multiple roles and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on metrics and reporting.
* Basic team mentoring or coordination experience.
* High attention to detail and a proactive, problem-solving approach.

**Company Description** 
 TNS India Foundation (TNSIF) is a section 25, non\-profit development organization that has been active in India since 2012\. The foundation designs and implements robust, demand\-driven programs that contribute to national economic reconstruction, with a strong emphasis on inclusive growth. TNSIF focuses on three core areas: youth employability, women entrepreneurship, and agriculture and natural resource management. The organization works closely with communities, partners, and employers to create sustainable livelihood opportunities and long\-term impact for diverse participant groups.

 The Placement Officer is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for connecting program participants with suitable employment and career opportunities. The Placement Officer will conduct career counseling sessions, organize training and employability workshops, and coordinate placement drives and interview processes. * Candidates should possess Training and facilitation skills to conduct workshops, mock interviews, and employability sessions.
* Candidates should possess Education\-related knowledge or experience, preferably in youth employability, vocational training, or similar programs.

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; a degree in social work, management, education, or related fields is an advantage.
* Comfort working with diverse communities, sensitivity to gender and inclusion, and readiness for field engagement when required.

title: Taleo Principal Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 Your potential has a place here with TTEC's award\-winning employment experience. As a Principal Analyst working onsite in Hyderabad, India, you'll be a part of bringing humanity to business. \#experienceTTEC
   

  

 Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in India says it all!
   

  

**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***End\-to\-End Recruitment Process \& Taleo Application Ownership***
* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root\-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.


***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) \& Integrations***
* Serve as the hands\-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat\-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.


***Implementation \& Project Delivery***
* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end\-to\-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.


***Stakeholder \& Vendor Management***
* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non\-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.


***Reporting, Compliance \& Mentoring***
* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***
* 8–12\+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands\-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.


***Technical \& Functional Skills***
* Strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.


***Soft Skills***
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross\-functional and cross\-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle ERP integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR/IT environments.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**What You Can Expect**

* An inclusive culture and community\-minded organization where giving back is encouraged

Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. **Position Profile:** 




 The contents of this role profile outline the role and responsibilities of the Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist.
 



  





**About Us:** 




 Head First Global PLC is a leading international HR\-tech and workforce solutions platform, connecting highly skilled professionals with organizations across Europe, the UK, the US, and APAC. The organization has entered a new phase of accelerated growth and transformation following its combination of Headfirst Group and Impellam Group. Backed by private equity, the group is executing an ambitious buy\-and\-build strategy, strengthening its position as a global market leader in flexible workforce solutions. We are embarking an ambitious transformation in the global workforce solutions industry—shifting at pace to a bold, differentiated platform model that will redefine how businesses and talent access, manage, and engage in work of the future.
 



  





**Overview :** 




 The Talent Acquisitions Sourcing Specialists serves as an essential partner to the Talent Acquisition Consultant, directly driving candidate generation and pipeline health to accelerate time to fill for roles. Operating at the front end of the recruitment life cycle, this position focuses on identifying, attracting, and engaging both active and passive talent through advanced sourcing techniques, market research, and targeted outreach. By conducting initial candidate evaluations and continually align search strategies with the TA Consultant, the TA Sourcing Specialist ensures a steady flow of high calibre candidates whilst evaluating overall efficiency and candidate experience of the hiring process.
 



  





**Key Duties and Responsibilities:** 




 Duties and responsibilities include but are not limited to the following tasks, criteria, and attributes to successfully perform the position of the Talent Acquisition Sourcing Specialist.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Proactively identify and map active and passive candidates using advanced Boolean logic, Linked in Recruiter, job boards, niche networks, and talent databases
* Assist in the recruitment and selection process by effectively engaging with candidates and by screening database applicants.
* Liaising with candidates / hiring managers to arrange interviews and sending out invites for roles as directed by the TA Consultant
* Ensure all aspects of talent acquisition are fully inclusive and proactively encourage and attract candidates from diverse groups by engaging with affiliated groups, memberships, and accreditations.
* Provide a first class, seamless candidate experience, conduct rigorous phone screens and evaluation to align with role specifications, technical capability, and candidate career motivations before passing candidate to the TA Consultant or Hiring Manager
* Research, identify, and proactively approach candidates using all appropriate methods.
* Qualify, and present suitable candidates by screening candidates.
* Assist in the development of candidate pipelines for key business functions.
* Use social media, email, and telephone to maintain engagement with top talent.
* Provide follow\-up feedback to candidates via phone and email. Key Skills
* Direct sourcing experience on LinkedIn and multiple Job Boards
* Strong understanding and experience with Boolean searches
* Experience working with ATS platforms.
* Excellent communication skills
* Sound knowledge of Microsoft Office software.
* Ability to priorities and manage own workload.
* Reliable and well organized
* Proactive
* Sound business ethics and integrity.
* Able to work well under pressure.
* Team player with a flexible and confident approach to work



  





**Key Relationships:** 



* Partner dynamically with the Talent Acquisition Consultant throughout the recruitment lifecycle, participating in hiring manager intake meetings



  





**Ideal Experience:** 



* Proven Talent Sourcing Track Record: 2\-4 years of dedicated candidate sourcing, talent acquisition, or agency recruitment experience, with demonstrated success in identifying and engaging candidates.
* Advanced Sourcing Expertise: Practical expertise using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search logic, candidate mapping, and alternative candidate discovery channels.
* Recruitment Tech \& Systems: Direct hands\-on experience utilizing Application Tracking Systems (ATS) and Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) tools (e.g. SuccessFactors, Workday, Recruitee) with high data accuracy.
* Stakeholder \& TA Alignment: Experience participating in briefing calls, calibrating candidate profiles against job requirements, and collaborating closely with TA Consultants or Senior Recruiters to drive shared hiring targets.
* Candidate Screen \& Engagement: Proven background conducting structured telephone or video screening interviews to access functional competencies, cultural alignment, and candidate motivators.
* Market Research \& Analytics: Demonstrated capability in compelling candidate landscape insights, talent market mapping, and utilizing sourcing metrics (conversation rates, channel efficiency) to optimize search strategies.



  





**Personal Characteristics:** 



* Curious \& Methodical: Processes a natural investigative mindset to dig beyond surface level keywords, uncover hard to find talent pools and continuously test new sourcing approaches
* Resilient and tenacious: Demonstrates high perseverance when navigating competitive talent markets and perusing passive candidates who may initially be non\-responsive
* Relationship Driven: Empathetic and engaging communicator who builds immediate rapport with candidates and establishes trust quickly with internal team members
* Agile \& Adaptative: Thrives in fast paced environments, effortlessly shifting focus across multiple requisitions and adapting strategies as business priorities evolve
* Data informed \& Analytical: Organized and detail orientated, using metrics and candidate feedback to track personal productivity and refine outreach methods
* Collaborative Partner: High team\-oriented with a strong service mindset, focused on supporting the TA Consultant to achieve collective hiring goals rather than working in isolation.
